text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so sex discrimination cannot explain why he was selected over you. While an all-male panel may reflect poor institutional diversity or outdated governance within the municipality, it provides no legal or factual basis for a complaint between two male candidates. 

Raising gender here would appear misguided and harm your professional reputation. The municipality likely prioritized political communication, stakeholder engagement, and public consultation skills over technical planning credentials. Instead of mentioning the panel's composition, follow up politely on your request for written feedback, framing your inquiry around professional development and understanding the specific competencies they prioritized.
